subject: Software Engineering
chapters: Software Project Management, Estimation and Maintenance

questions.text: Differentiate between functional and non-functional requirements. Explain the requirements engineering process: elicitation, analysis, specification, and validation.
What was the software crisis in the history of software engineering? Discuss the characteristics of good software and why software engineering principles are essential.
Explain the Prototyping Model and Spiral Model of software development. Under what circumstances is each model preferred over the Waterfall model?
Prepare a Use Case diagram and Sequence diagram for an Online Ticket Booking System with necessary actors, use cases, include/extend relationships, and message interactions.
Draw a Class diagram and Activity diagram for a Flight Management System or Online Examination System showing associations, multiplicities, attributes, and methods.
What is software architecture? Differentiate between Repository model, Layered model, and Client-Server architectural styles with suitable block diagrams.
What distinguishes Black Box testing from White Box testing? Explain Equivalence Partitioning and Boundary Value Analysis with concrete test case examples.
Describe Cyclomatic Complexity as a software testing metric. How is basis path testing conducted using a control flow graph (CFG) to derive test cases ensuring full path coverage?
Differentiate between Software Verification and Software Validation. Explain how Formal Technical Review (FTR) is conducted in Software Quality Assurance (SQA).
What is Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI)? Explain the 5 maturity levels of CMMI and their key process areas.

questions.chapter: Software Project Management, Estimation and Maintenance
questions.text: What is COCOMO? Explain Basic and Intermediate COCOMO models. Calculate effort and development time in person-months given project size in KLOC.

questions.chapter: Software Project Management, Estimation and Maintenance
questions.text: Define Software Configuration Management (SCM). Explain version control, change control, configuration audit, and status accounting activities.
What are the benefits and problems of software reuse? What is Component-Based Software Engineering (CBSE) and COTS (Commercial Off-The-Shelf) reuse?
Explain real-time systems. Differentiate between Hard real-time systems and Soft real-time systems with examples, and explain periodic and aperiodic stimuli.
Briefly explain iterative development in OOSE. What are the different phases and disciplines of the Rational Unified Process (RUP)?

questions.chapter: Software Project Management, Estimation and Maintenance
questions.text: What are the main processes of Risk Management in software engineering? Explain risk identification, risk projection, and Risk Mitigation, Monitoring, and Management (RMMM) plan.
